title: Vercel deployment docs contradict each other and the WIP pathname routes; the applicable root vercel.json has no rewrite for /demo, /login, /signup
trigger: Follow docs/deployment-vercel.md (Root Directory = repository root, line 11; 'no catch-all rewrite is needed', line 20) and deploy the WIP tree; on the deployed / landing click Log in, Sign up or View the demo (apps/web/src/landing/Landing.tsx:39-47 link to /login, /signup, /demo) or navigate directly to those paths.
expected: The single page is served for /demo, /login and /signup, as the local wrapper does (apps/web/scripts/serve.mjs:107 appRoutes; evidence/r1-08-serve-test.log 7/7 passed).
actual: With Root Directory at the repository root only the committed root vercel.json applies; it contains headers but no rewrites key, and dist/ holds only index.html and reva.svg at its root (evidence/r1-21-dist-inventory.log), so a static host returns 404 for those paths (predicted, not reproduced). The alternative instruction in apps/web/README.md:52 (Root Directory = apps/web so the nested apps/web/vercel.json rewrites apply) contradicts docs/deployment-vercel.md:18 and apps/web/README.md:34, which require the repository root because prepare-assets.mjs reads apps/ios/Reva/Resources outside apps/web. docs/build-progress.md:157 repeats the hash-route claim that main.tsx:20-35 no longer satisfies.
impact: On the deployed browser entry every landing action would dead-end and operators receive two incompatible deployment instructions. Local behaviour is unaffected. The hosted-backend boundary (L02) itself is documented correctly.
evidence: sed -n '11p;18p;20p' docs/deployment-vercel.md; sed -n '157p' docs/build-progress.md; sed -n '34p;52p' apps/web/README.md; cat vercel.json (no rewrites); cat apps/web/vercel.json (three exact rewrites); sed -n '20,35p' apps/web/src/main.tsx; git diff -U0 -- apps/web/README.md (line 52 added by the WIP delta, line 34 committed in cfe0997); evidence/r1-21-dist-inventory.log; evidence/r1-08-serve-test.log.
smallestFix: Keep the repository-root model: add exact rewrites for /demo, /login, /signup (later /app) to the root vercel.json, leaving /v1, /health, /assets, /demo/* files and /ocr/* unrewritten; delete or empty apps/web/vercel.json; correct docs/deployment-vercel.md:20, docs/build-progress.md:157 and apps/web/README.md:52 to describe pathname routes and the single config location.
regressionCheck: node --test apps/web/scripts/serve.test.mjs for local parity; owner-run Vercel preview: curl -sI https://<preview>/login expecting 200 text/html and curl -sI https://<preview>/v1/state expecting no HTML rewrite (ER-01-2).

title: Checked-in packet PDF still says gemini-2.5-flash after the WIP delta renamed the model in its Markdown source and generator
trigger: The WIP model rename (README.md:54, docs/architecture.md:86, docs/project-overview-packet.md:168, scripts/build_overview_packet.py) is committed without regenerating output/pdf/reva-project-overview-packet.pdf.
expected: README.md:76 says both packet forms are rebuilt together; PDF and Markdown agree on the model and the packet describes the baseline it claims.
actual: Read-only pypdf extraction of the unmodified PDF finds 'gemini-2.5-flash.' on page 6 and 'baseline d0af1df' on every page, while the Markdown source now says gemini-3.8-flash and still declares 'Code baseline d0af1df' at line 3.
evidence: git diff -U0 -- docs/project-overview-packet.md (line 168 changed); git status --porcelain (PDF unmodified); python3 -c "import pypdf,re;r=pypdf.PdfReader('output/pdf/reva-project-overview-packet.pdf');print([(i,m) for i,p in enumerate(r.pages,1) for m in re.findall(r'gemini[-\w.]*',p.extract_text() or '',re.I)])" -> (6, 'gemini-2.5-flash.'); sed -n '76p' README.md.
smallestFix: Before committing the rename, regenerate the PDF with scripts/build_overview_packet.py (owner-run, not the audit runner) or revert the packet edit and add a dated note.
regressionCheck: Repeat the pypdf extraction and expect gemini-3.8-flash on page 6 (ER-01-4).
